attributes.action: For transgender people to have access to healthcare
attributes.additional_details: As of today trans people don’t have access to the appropriate healthcare they need under the NHS which really impacts their mental and physical health. Without the appropriate healthcare trans people are significantly higher risk of  self-harm, social anxiety, suicidal thoughts , depression and more
attributes.background: To allow transgender people to have appropriate access to the healthcare they need e.g. hormone blockers , HRT

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign this petition which calls for the same action:

Enshrine in Law Access to Hormone Replacement Therapy for Transgender Adults
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/763957
